data.input: Identify which required file is missing and explain how this blocks the original checklist.

rawInput.command: for f in release_checklist.md RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md checklist.md CHECKLIST.md RELEASE.md CHANGELOG.md README.md VERSION package.json Cargo.toml pyproject.toml Makefile; do [ -e "/home/agent/workspace/$f" ] && echo "EXISTS: $f"; done; echo "---"; [ -d /home/agent/workspace/.git ] && echo "git repo present" || echo "no .git directory"; echo "---"; find /home/agent/workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path "*/.kuma/*"
rawInput.intent: Confirm absence of checklist and all common release artifacts
